# The AI Loadout — full directory

223 AI tools ranked S/A/B/C across 17 use-case loadouts (244 rankings, since some tools appear in more than one loadout). Last updated 2026-10-15. Source: https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/

## Coding / Vibe Coding (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/coding/)
1. Cursor (https://cursor.com) — Best all-round AI code editor for shipping real apps fast. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Claude Code (https://claude.com/product/claude-code) — Best terminal agent for big multi-file changes. Pricing: Paid (Claude plan/API)
3. Muse Wonder (https://dev.meta.ai) — Best Meta frontier model for long coding-agent runs. Pricing: Paid (API + Muse Code)
4. OpenAI Codex (https://openai.com/codex/) — Best for delegating coding tasks to cloud agents. Pricing: Included with ChatGPT plans
5. GitHub Copilot (https://github.com/features/copilot) — Best inside VS Code and GitHub workflows. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Lovable (https://lovable.dev) — Best for idea-to-full-stack app with zero setup. Pricing: Free tier + paid
7. Bolt.new (https://bolt.new) — Best for instant in-browser prototypes. Pricing: Free tier + paid
8. v0 (https://v0.app) — Best for polished React/Next.js UIs. Pricing: Free tier + paid
9. Replit (https://replit.com) — Best for building and hosting in one place. Pricing: Free tier + paid
10. Deltix (https://app.deltix.ai) — AI agent that runs plain-English test tasks on your mobile app in a simulator. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
11. Offrun (https://offrun.dev/) — Mac workspace to run several coding agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
12. SKI (https://heyski.io/) — Voice assistant that lets you talk out loud with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
13. Shikigami (https://shikigami.dev/) — Agentic IDE that runs Claude Code, Codex and opencode in parallel, each in its own worktree. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing

## AI Agents (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/agents/)
1. ChatGPT Agent (https://chatgpt.com) — Best general-purpose agent for everyday tasks. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. Manus (https://manus.im) — Best for long autonomous research and task runs. Pricing: Free credits + paid
3. n8n (https://n8n.io) — Best for building your own agent workflows (self-hostable). Pricing: Free self-host + paid cloud
4. Zapier Agents (https://zapier.com/agents) — Best for agents that touch 7,000+ apps. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. CrewAI (https://www.crewai.com) — Best framework for multi-agent teams in code. Pricing: Open source + paid cloud
6. LangGraph (https://www.langchain.com/langgraph) — Best for controllable, stateful agent code. Pricing: Open source
7. Agent.reviews (https://agent.reviews/) — Directory where coding agents review the software tools they used on real tasks. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
8. OzBrain (https://ozbrain.com) — Shared knowledge base that Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents can all read and write. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
9. MarbleOS (https://marbleos.com/demo) — Experimental visual workspace for AI agents with visible files, tools and tasks. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
10. Traccia (https://traccia.ai/) — Control plane for observability, evaluation and runtime policy on production AI agents. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing

9. Airy (https://airy.so) — Free text-to-speech studio for creators plus a low-cost TTS API. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
10. StudioEditor (https://studioeditor.io/) — Browser-based audio and video podcast editor with AI enhancement and AutoDuck. Pricing: Free account with 60 credits; check site for current pricing
11. Seply (https://seply.org/) — AI speaker separation that splits a mixed recording into one WAV per speaker, 30+ languages. Pricing: check site for current pricing

## Research / Search (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/research/)
1. Perplexity (https://www.perplexity.ai) — Best answer engine with sources. Pricing: Free tier + paid
2. NotebookLM (https://notebooklm.google.com) — Best for studying your own docs (and audio overviews). Pricing: Free tier + paid
3. ChatGPT Deep Research (https://chatgpt.com) — Best for multi-page research reports. Pricing: Included with ChatGPT plans
4. Elicit (https://elicit.com) — Best for academic papers. Pricing: Free tier + paid
5. Grok (https://grok.com) — Best for real-time research across X and the web. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Undermind (https://www.undermind.ai/) — Deep literature search agent that reads full texts and finds papers others miss. Pricing: Free; Pro $16/mo
7. Litmaps (https://www.litmaps.com/) — Citation-map literature discovery and alerts. Pricing: Free; Pro $10/mo
8. Anara (https://anara.com/) — Research workspace with every claim cited to its source. Pricing: Free; paid from $10/mo
9. AnswerThis (https://answerthis.io/) — AI literature reviews over 250M+ papers with verifiable citations. Pricing: Free; paid from $14/mo
10. Moonlight (https://www.themoonlight.io/) — AI reading companion that explains research papers in place. Pricing: Free; see site for paid
11. Paperguide (https://paperguide.ai/) — AI systematic reviews, reference manager and research agents. Pricing: Paid from $12/mo
12. Scry (https://scry.io/) — Research add-on for ChatGPT or Claude that reads forums, papers, filings and markets for you. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
13. Attache (https://attache.news/) — AI news briefing that calls you each morning; ask questions and go deeper by phone. Pricing: Free week of Premium, then $19.99/mo (up to 10 hrs/month)
14. Scholarcy (https://www.scholarcy.com/) — AI summary flashcards for academic papers. Pricing: Free summarizer; paid on site
15. Humata (https://www.humata.ai/) — Chat with documents and build a searchable knowledge base. Pricing: Free; Expert $9.99/mo; Team $49/user/mo
16. Keenious (https://keenious.com/) — Recommends papers based on what you are writing in Word or Docs. Pricing: Free; Plus $10/mo
17. Avidnote (https://avidnote.com/) — AI workspace for reading, writing and analyzing research. Pricing: See site for pricing
18. Sourcely (https://www.sourcely.net/) — Finds academic sources and citations for your text. Pricing: From $9/mo
19. SciSummary (https://scisummary.com/) — AI summaries of scientific articles. Pricing: Free; $4/mo
20. Paper Digest (https://www.paperdigest.org/) — AI research platform for reading and writing with papers. Pricing: See site for pricing
21. Petal (https://www.petal.org/) — Chat with and analyze your documents with sourced answers. Pricing: See site for pricing
22. Kahubi (https://kahubi.com/) — EU-hosted academic assistant: papers, stats, interview coding, cited drafts. Pricing: Free; paid $29-$109/mo
23. ResearchPal (https://researchpal.co/) — AI research writing and literature review assistant. Pricing: Free; paid from $9/mo
24. Nouswise (https://nouswise.com/) — Thinking partner with source-traceable answers over your content. Pricing: From $10/mo
25. ScholarAI (https://scholarai.io/) — AI research assistant for papers, citations and study guides. Pricing: See site for pricing

5. Cascadeur (https://cascadeur.com/) — AI-assisted keyframe character animation with auto-physics, mocap cleanup and AI motion generation. Pricing: Free plan; Indie $19/mo ($8/mo billed annually)

9. Retro Diffusion (https://retrodiffusion.ai/) — AI pixel-art generator built for game sprites and tiles. Pricing: check site for current pricing
10. God Mode AI (https://www.godmodeai.co/) — Sprite and animation generator for games: looping animations, multiple camera views, VFX, commercial license. Pricing: $29/mo (200 generations) or credit packs from $32
11. AutoSprite (https://www.autosprite.io/) — Upload one sprite, pick a moveset, export engine-ready sprite sheets for Unity, Godot, GameMaker and Phaser. Pricing: Free plan; Starter $12/mo, Pro $29/mo
12. Atlas (https://atlas.design/) — Governed node canvas over 100+ AI models for game, CGI and 3D asset pipelines; runs in Unreal, Unity, Blender or via API. Pricing: Pro €50/mo, Studio €200/mo
13. Ludus AI (https://ludusengine.com/) — Unreal Engine AI toolkit: C++ and Blueprint generation, scenes, UE5 answers. Pricing: Free trial; check site for plans
14. Coplay (https://coplay.dev/) — AI assistant inside the Unity editor that builds and edits scenes, scripts and assets. Pricing: Free plan; Pro $20/mo
15. Bezi (https://www.bezi.com/) — Unity-aware AI assistant for debugging, code generation, shaders and prototyping. Pricing: Free tier; Pro $20/mo, Advanced $60/mo
16. nunu.ai (https://nunu.ai/) — AI agents that playtest games and apps like a human across 60+ real devices. Pricing: Free starter credits; plans from $200/mo
17. Sprite AI (https://www.sprite-ai.art/) — Text-to-pixel-art sprite maker for 2D games. Pricing: Free tier; paid plans up to $50/mo
18. Jabali (https://www.jabali.ai/) — No-code AI game maker: describe a game, play and remix it in minutes. Pricing: Free to start; Premium $9.99/mo
19. SoonLab (https://www.soonlab.ai/) — Prompt-to-playable browser game maker with edit, publish and remix. Pricing: Free starter credits; check site for plans
20. UGCraft AI (https://www.ugcraft.ai/) — Text/image-to-3D maker for Roblox UGC accessories and clothing. Pricing: Free tier; Creator $15/mo ($9/mo billed annually)
21. modl.ai (https://modl.ai/) — AI agents for automated game QA and playtesting, no SDK required. Pricing: Book a demo (pricing not public)

14. Curipod (https://curipod.com) — Best for interactive lessons with AI writing feedback. Pricing: Free for teachers + paid
15. Wolfram Alpha (https://www.wolframalpha.com) — Best for exact computation and STEM checks. Pricing: Free tier + paid
16. Grammarly (https://www.grammarly.com) — Best for polishing essays and grammar. Pricing: Free tier + paid
17. Elicit (https://elicit.com) — Best for lit reviews and paper summaries. Pricing: Free tier + paid
18. Otter.ai (https://otter.ai) — Best for recording and transcribing lectures. Pricing: Free tier + paid
19. Goblin Tools (https://www.goblin.tools) — Best for breaking assignments into steps (great for ADHD). Pricing: Free + paid Pro
20. Zotero (https://www.zotero.org) — Best free citation manager (not AI; pairs with Elicit). Pricing: Free + paid storage
21. Lathoa (https://lathoa.ai/en) — Critical-thinking math app for kids 10-14 where the AI robot is wrong on purpose. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
22. Academa (https://academa.ai/) — Library of AI-generated technical lecture videos with chat alongside each video. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
23. SubSmith (https://subsmith.app) — Turns videos into language-learning material with transcripts, instant definitions and Anki export. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
24. Knowable (https://useknowable.ai/) — Camera-based AI tutor app that coaches students through textbook problems. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
25. HOPE (https://usehope.app) — Personalized daily math practice for grades 2-12 with progress shown to parents. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
26. Perfectum AI (https://perfectum.ai/) — AI-native LMS that builds courses from prompts and docs, with cohorts, certificates and licensing. Pricing: 14-day free trial; check site for current pricing

2. Eklipse (https://eklipse.gg) — Best for auto-clipping Twitch gaming highlights. Pricing: Free preview; Premium $24.99/mo to export
3. StreamLadder (https://streamladder.com) — Best for vertical clips from streams. Pricing: Free tier + paid

## Open-Source & Local Models (https://zachlaboyteaux-boop.github.io/ailoadout/local-models/)
1. Ollama (https://ollama.com) — Best one-command way to run models locally. Pricing: Free / open source
2. LM Studio (https://lmstudio.ai) — Best desktop app for local models with a GUI. Pricing: Free
3. LFM2.5-24B-A2B (https://www.liquid.ai/blog/lfm2-5-24b-a2b) — Best open MoE for on-device agents (24B total, 2B active). Pricing: Open weights
4. DeepSeek (https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai) — Top open-weights reasoning and coding models to run locally. Pricing: Free open weights
5. Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co) — Best hub for open models, datasets and demos. Pricing: Free tier + paid
6. Stable Diffusion (https://stability.ai/stable-image) — The go-to open image model for local generation in ComfyUI and similar apps. Pricing: Free open weights (Community License under $1M revenue)
7. AnythingLLM (https://anythingllm.com/) — Free, private all-in-one local AI app: chat with docs, agents, any model. Pricing: Free desktop app; hosted from $50/mo
8. Open WebUI (https://openwebui.com) — Best self-hosted ChatGPT-style interface. Pricing: Free / open source
9. llama.cpp (https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) — Best engine for fast local inference on any hardware. Pricing: Open source
10. Jan (https://www.jan.ai) — Best privacy-first offline assistant. Pricing: Free / open source
11. ComfyUI (https://www.comfy.org) — Best node-based local image/video generation. Pricing: Free / open source
12. Cactus Needle (https://cactuscompute.com/needle) — Tiny 8-29 MB foundation model built for phones, wearables, robots and microcontrollers. Pricing: Indie launch; check site for current pricing
13. LocalAI (https://localai.io/) — Open-source, OpenAI-compatible server to run text, voice and image models locally. Pricing: Free, open source (MIT)
14. Msty (https://msty.ai/) — Polished private AI app for local and cloud models with workspaces and knowledge stacks. Pricing: Free; paid plans on site
15. Private LLM (https://privatellm.app/) — Run Llama, Qwen and DeepSeek fully offline on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Pricing: One-time App Store purchase
16. Chatbox AI (https://chatboxai.app/) — Desktop and mobile chat client for cloud APIs and local models. Pricing: Free; Lite $3.50/mo, Pro $16.70/mo
17. Locally AI (https://locallyai.app/) — Run open models offline on iPhone, iPad and Mac (now part of LM Studio). Pricing: Free
18. Enclave AI (https://enclaveai.app/) — Offline AI assistant for iPhone and Mac with local voice chat. Pricing: Free; Pro $9.99/mo
19. Backyard AI (https://backyard.ai/) — Local-model character chat app with lorebooks. Pricing: Free local app; see site
20. Fullmoon (https://fullmoon.app/) — Minimal open-source app to chat with local LLMs on Apple devices. Pricing: Free, open source
21. Layla (https://www.layla-network.ai/) — Private offline AI assistant and character chat for Android and iOS. Pricing: See site for pricing
22. BoltAI (https://boltai.com/) — Native Mac AI app for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and local LLMs. Pricing: From $79 one-time
23. RecurseChat (https://recurse.chat/) — Mac app for chatting with local AI models and your files. Pricing: Paid Mac app ($19.99-$29.99)
24. Osaurus (https://osaurus.ai/) — Open local AI agents that run on your Mac. Pricing: Free; Workspaces $20/mo
25. LocalMode (https://localmode.ai/) — Developer kit of React components that run AI models on-device in the browser. Pricing: Free, open source
